findings.title: website_name leaks the profile website to anonymous viewers of TL0 users
findings.body: `:website_name` is added to the plain `attributes` list, but it is not added to the `untrusted_attributes` list (lines 105-111). `website`, `location`, `bio_raw` and `profile_background` are all hidden for TL0 users seen by anonymous visitors, via `scope.restrict_user_fields?`. `website_name` is derived directly from `website`, so for a TL0 user it is still serialized. Anonymous users can therefore see the website host, and with this change the full URL path, which the restriction was meant to hide. The TL0 spec (spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb line 11) still lists only the old untrusted attributes, so it does not catch the leak. Fix: add `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` and extend the spec's list.
